scope: Read-only verification that the checkout is the sole development Git, that the public history contains no credentials, and that machine-specific paths and external-resource examples are accounted for.

git_uniqueness.scan_covers: Every directory under the runtime root except .cache, output, temp and node_modules; reparse points are not followed, so junction targets outside the root are not counted as runtime repositories.
git_uniqueness.note: G:\ComfyUI-aki-v3\git is the launcher's PortableGit distribution, not a repository.

external_repositories.note: Retired history, audit clones and validation clones. They are not developable sources and are not published.

publication_credential_scan.covers: All reachable commits, tags, blobs and historical path aliases, including deleted files, commit/tag messages and compressed payloads.
publication_credential_scan.does_not_cover: Legal/redistribution rights for third-party text, images and models; and machine-specific absolute paths, which are not credentials.

tracked_path_exposure.assessment: Machine-specific absolute paths only. Most are deliberate local-layout statements in this machine's own documentation and in offline helper scripts; none is a credential.
tracked_path_exposure.decision: Not rewritten. The archived originals are byte-registered in governance/technical-archive.json, so rewriting them would invalidate the archive registry for a non-credential detail. Use scripts/workspace_audit.py to re-measure, and relocate paths by runtime root when moving machines.

mapping.workflows: real workflow JSON is tracked in Git, so no synthetic sample is needed

external_example_coverage.note: No payload, weight, real preview or credential is included by any example file.

live_instance_equation.statement: Local instance = reviewed public Git files + large asset and image caches outside Git + private configuration store outside Git.
live_instance_equation.git_role: Sole development and commit source: code, workflows/subgraphs, reviewed prompt exports, database contracts and migrations, maintenance tooling.
live_instance_equation.external_assets_role: Models, prompt-library previews/thumbnails, plugin-owned weights, environment and current mutable databases; registered by relative path and not copied into Git.
live_instance_equation.private_config_role: API keys, session material and machine settings; never public and never a second development source.
live_instance_equation.private_store_note: G:\ComfyUI-local is a plain local directory with restricted ACLs, not a versioned Git repository and not encrypted. Calling it a private store does not imply version history, automatic sync or off-site backup.
live_instance_equation.verified_by: scripts/external_state.py (offline manifest and private overlay), scripts/workspace_audit.py (uniqueness and exposure)

covered: extra repository breaks the sole claim

boundaries: Credential scanning proves absence of detected secrets, not absence of every possible secret pattern.
The Git uniqueness check covers this host's runtime root and external root only.
Machine paths were measured, not rewritten; a future sanitisation pass would need a separate reviewed plan.
No production service, database, workflow or prompt library was modified; no dependency was installed and nothing was uploaded.
